developments.visible_change: Under the locked wide camera, three photorealistic capybaras stand in the left, center, and right slots of the row on the polished wooden floor, replacing the three suited men; starting with the leftmost, they drop flat onto the boards in rapid succession, the center following and then the rightmost, each flopping belly-down with its short legs tucked under and its fur pressing against the wood.
developments.outcome: All three capybaras lie flat on the floor in a row, holding the left, center, and right start slots.

developments.visible_change: The capybara in the left slot pushes off its forelegs and springs sideways into the center slot, landing belly-down beside the capybara already there; as it lands, the capybara in the center slot rolls over its shoulder across the boards into the left slot and slides flat to a stop.
developments.outcome: The two capybaras have exchanged slots: the capybara that began on the left lies in the center and the one that began in the center lies at the left, with the right capybara still flat in its slot.

developments.visible_change: The capybara lying in the center slot rolls sideways toward the right slot while the capybara lying in the right slot springs up and jumps into the vacated center slot, the two crossing the floor in one quick exchange.
developments.outcome: The two capybaras have exchanged slots: the capybara from the center lies flat at the right and the capybara from the right occupies the center slot, with the third capybara still flat at the left.

developments.visible_change: The capybara in the center slot pushes up on its forelegs and jumps onto the backs of the two capybaras lying flat at the left and right of the row, landing across both backs and settling into a stacked pyramid.
developments.outcome: The three capybaras hold a stacked pyramid on the floor: two lying flat with the third resting across their backs, remaining still until the video ends.

shots.content_purpose: Hold the single locked wide shot that shows the three capybaras replacing the suited men, their rapid successive lie-downs, the two slot exchanges, and the final stacked pyramid, with photorealistic fur and environment-matched light and shadow.
shots.description: A static wide shot from the fixed camera position of <Video 1> holds the polished light-brown wooden floor with its white circular markings, and the camera never moves, zooms, or cuts. Three photorealistic capybaras, <Subject 1> at the left, <Subject 2> at the center, and <Subject 3> at the right, replace the three suited men in the same slots of the row and stand on the floor while the woman in white from <Video 1> remains at the left edge of the frame. In rapid succession <Subject 1>, then <Subject 2>, then <Subject 3> drop flat onto the boards, each flopping belly-down with its short legs tucked under, fur pressing against the wood, and a low dull impact sounding through the room. <Subject 1> then pushes off its forelegs and springs sideways into the center slot, landing belly-down beside <Subject 2>; as <Subject 1> lands, <Subject 2> rolls over its shoulder from the center slot into the left slot, rotating across the boards and sliding flat to a stop with a light scuff of claws. <Subject 1> then rolls sideways from the center toward the right slot while <Subject 3> springs up out of the right slot and jumps into the vacated center slot, the two crossing the floor in one quick exchange. Finally <Subject 3> pushes up from the center slot and jumps onto the backs of <Subject 2> and <Subject 1> lying flat at the left and right of the row, landing across both backs with a soft thud and settling into a stacked pyramid; all three hold flat and still until the video ends, their fur and contact shadows resting under the room's existing light.

uncertainties: The user's chain is ambiguous about which capybara occupies the center at each step; the plan resolves it as two consecutive slot exchanges so that the capybara that came from the right ends on top of the pyramid. A different reading would change which capybara finishes on top.

The user's stated sequence contains more movement phases than the three events visible in the source analysis, which shows the pyramid formed from roughly 3.0 s onward; the plan keeps the user's order and the source tempo inside 5.875 s, so the two exchanges each last about a second and may read briefly.

The user does not mention the woman in white who is visible at the left edge of <Video 1>; the plan keeps her standing at the frame edge as visible source content, and retention should be confirmed if she is unwanted.
No audio analysis of <Video 1> exists, so the soundscape is newly designed; if the source's original track must be reused, an audio reference and reuse scope would be required.
